scope.goal: Crear una versión candidata reproducible y congelar nuevas features sin tocar main ni Producción.
inScope: Pin del candidato por SHA inmutable de Desarrollo.

Política de feature freeze: no aceptar nuevas features sobre el candidato; sólo correcciones causales P0/P1 o ajustes estrictamente necesarios para certificar el RC, con recertificación si cambia el producto.
Evidencia de QA/regresión/seguridad/migración/backup/restore aplicable al candidato o equivalencia demostrada.
Documentación/certificación del RC y trazabilidad del SHA candidato.
outOfScope: Nuevas features de dominio, API o UI.

affectedSurfaces.securityRbac: NO_NEW_POLICY_EXPECTED; existing controls must remain certified

risks.mitigation: Any product-tree change after the pinned candidate invalidates equivalence and requires new candidate SHA plus recertification.
Treat new feature changes as out of scope; only causal closure fixes may proceed and must be revalidated.
Authority keeps main frozen, PR #2 OPEN+DRAFT, merge and Producción prohibited.
RC identity is the immutable candidate product/control SHA; later evidence-only commits require explicit equivalence, not silent rebasing.

acceptanceCriteria: No P0/P1 discovered by directed preflight.

rollbackStrategy.strategy: No deployment occurs in N9.1.A. If candidate evidence or later RC work is invalid, keep main/Producción untouched, mark the affected N9.1 scope non-LISTO, select a new Desarrollo candidate SHA only after the causal fix, then rerun applicable gates.

testStrategy.preTask: No product mutation in A; no new expensive CI is causal to this audit-only step.
testStrategy.later: N9.1.G must certify applicable unit/integration/contract/E2E/security/migration/performance coverage against the pinned candidate or demonstrated product-equivalent head.
